pricing.pricing_notes: Command Code Provider is a $15/month plan with pay-as-you-go usage, no markup on upstream model prices, deals applied automatically, and credits that roll over.

auth.notes: Users create an API key in Command Code Studio (https://commandcode.ai/studio); the same key authenticates the CLI and the API. HTTP auth uses Authorization: Bearer <CMD_API_KEY> on any route, or x-api-key for the Anthropic SDK on /messages.

feature_gaps_in_compat_mode: Claude models must use the Anthropic /messages route while OpenAI and open-source models must use /chat/completions; wrong-endpoint requests return 400.
The OpenAI and Anthropic routes expose different error envelope shapes (error.code vs error.type).
